companyDescription: Commercial CNS/derm pharma · Fanapt, HETLIOZ, newly approved BYSANTI (bipolar I / schizophrenia), and imsidolimab (IL-36R antibody for generalized pustular psoriasis) awaiting a Dec 12 PDUFA — a revenue-generating company trading near 52-week lows
priceNote: Live $3.78 (+0.8%) on Nov 4, 2026, down ~7% from $4.055 at the Oct 26 report and just above the $3.64 52-week low (high $9.94). Market cap ~$228M, below FY26 revenue guidance of $240-290M. Nov 4 tape: S&P futures -1.2% / Nasdaq -2% on a Democratic midterm sweep; Dec 9 hike ~85% priced.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Oct 26, 2026). The Dec 12, 2026 PDUFA for imsidolimab in generalized pustular psoriasis is intact. The pivotal GEMINI-1/2 data (53% GPPGA 0/1 at week 4 vs 13% on placebo after a single IV dose) were published in NEJM Evidence, and partner AnaptysBio publicly expects approval in December. Vanda trades at ~0.8-0.9x FY26 revenue guidance ($240-290M) after the Oct 14 VQW-765 Phase 3 failure, so the setup is a rerating from a distressed multiple, not a 10x drug story. GPP is ultra-rare and Spevigo is already approved, so approval alone is not a 3x catalyst. The Moon case needs BYSANTI launch traction plus imsidolimab. fda_decision is a Tier-2 LEADER (+9.3pp vs +2.0pp, n=10). Base +50% (~$5.67) assumes approval plus a stabilizing loss rate over ~1-3 months, above the lane's 30-day P90 (+25.9%; Base bias +72.7pp). แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้าโดน CRL ลงได้ 30-40%.

catalysts.name: Imsidolimab BLA — PDUFA (GPP)
catalysts.description: FDA target action date for imsidolimab (Quimilza) in generalized pustular psoriasis; BLA accepted Feb 2026. GEMINI-1/2: 53% GPPGA 0/1 at week 4 vs 13% placebo after a single IV dose (NEJM Evidence, Apr 2026). AnaptysBio expects approval in December.

catalysts.name: BYSANTI commercial launch
catalysts.description: Launch of the newly approved bipolar I / schizophrenia drug. Early script trends determine whether the revenue guide and the 'funded through 2027' claim hold.

risks: Losses are heavy: H1 2026 net loss of $111.1M (Q2 alone $62.5M) against $170M cash at Jun 30. The 'funded through 2027' guide depends on revenue growth and on expenses falling as promised.
The VQW-765 social-anxiety Phase 3 failed on Oct 14, 2026, widening the pipeline-credibility discount.
GPP is ultra-rare and spesolimab (Spevigo) is already approved, so imsidolimab's revenue ceiling is modest. Approval alone is not a 3x catalyst.
BYSANTI launches into a crowded, heavily genericized antipsychotic market; early scripts may disappoint.
Vanda has a long history of FDA disputes and litigation, which adds idiosyncratic regulatory risk.

estimateDates.note: Second recent approval decision after BYSANTI; partner AnaptysBio expects approval
BYSANTI launch metrics and cash burn vs the 'through 2027' runway guide

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 (10–2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented for a hike). Futures price ~85% odds of another +25bp at the Dec 9 FOMC after Logan and Musalem called for more tightening; Warsh gave no explicit December signal.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Sep PCE: headline 3.6% y/y (+0.5% m/m), core 3.1% y/y (+0.3% m/m); Q3 GDP +3.4% annualized. Oct CPI on Nov 10 is the next test — core ≥0.4% m/m would effectively lock in the December hike.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Commercial specialty pharma with real revenue, so it is less rate-sensitive than pre-revenue biotech. Rates still matter through the cost of funding losses until the loss rate narrows.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the Dec 12 PDUFA comes three days after the Dec 9 FOMC (~85% hike priced). A revenue-backed balance sheet makes this the least macro-fragile name on the board.

catalystSpot.preRunup: No run-up yet: the stock is ~7% lower since Oct 26 and sits near its 52-week low after the Oct 14 VQW-765 failure.

postWin.note: PharmaTher's KETARx approval (Aug 2025) re-rated the stock +148% over ~6 months. That was a single small-cap approval; Vanda's revenue base dampens both tails.

postLose.note: CRL reactions: CAPR -33% day 1 (Jul 2025), OTLK -80% day 1 (Dec 2025). Vanda's revenue floor should keep a CRL nearer the mild end.

spotSizing.reason: 2%. fda_decision is a Tier-2 LEADER (+9.3pp vs +2.0pp, n=10), and the approval odds look high, but the small GPP market and ~$60M/quarter losses cap the upside per dollar of risk.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the fda_decision medianMAE (-18.4%, n=10). A break below ~$2.95 pre-PDUFA means the market is pricing a CRL or a financing.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If FDA issues a CRL for imsidolimab, exit day 1 — the revenue floor cushions less than it looks while losses run at ~$60M a quarter.

comparableCases.note: A small-cap approval re-rated over ~6 months, not in a day. That fits VNDA's Base/Bull as a multi-month re-rating.

risks: ขาดทุนหนัก: ขาดทุนสุทธิ H1 2026 $111.1M (Q2 อย่างเดียว $62.5M) เทียบเงินสด $170M ณ 30 มิ.ย. คำกล่าวว่า 'มีเงินถึงปี 2027' ขึ้นกับการเติบโตของรายได้และค่าใช้จ่ายที่ลดลงตามที่สัญญา
Phase 3 ของ VQW-765 (social anxiety) ล้มเหลว 14 ต.ค. 2026 ทำให้ความน่าเชื่อถือของ pipeline ถูกหักลดมากขึ้น
GPP เป็นโรคหายากมากและมี spesolimab (Spevigo) อนุมัติแล้ว เพดานรายได้ของ imsidolimab จึงจำกัด การอนุมัติอย่างเดียวไม่ใช่ catalyst 3 เท่า
BYSANTI เปิดตัวในตลาดยารักษาโรคจิตที่แออัดและเต็มไปด้วยยาสามัญ ใบสั่งยาช่วงแรกอาจน่าผิดหวัง
Vanda มีประวัติขัดแย้งและฟ้องร้องกับ FDA ยาวนาน เพิ่มความเสี่ยงด้าน regulatory เฉพาะตัว
